description_en: Resets a quota throttling rule on a gateway
description_zh: 重置网关上某条配额限流规则
kebab_example: aliyun apig reset-gateway-quota-rule --gateway-id gw-123456 --rule-id qr-d8j7fpmm1hksxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetGatewayQuotaRule

parameters.description_en: The unique identifier of the gateway.
parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the gateway
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.description_en: The total available quota per period after the reset.
parameters.description_zh: 重置后周期可用总额度
parameters.help_en: The total available quota per period after the reset
parameters.help_zh: 重置后周期可用总额度
parameters.name: quota_limit

parameters.description_en:
The period alignment type after the reset. Valid values:
- calendar: calendar period.
- epoch: custom period. Custom periods are supported only on dedicated instances running version 2.1.19 or later.
parameters.description_zh: 重置周期类型。支持自然周期（windowAlignment=calendar）和自定义周期（windowAlignment=epoch）。其中，自定义周期仅适用于 2.1.19 及以上版本的专享实例
parameters.help_en:
The period alignment type after the reset. Valid values:
- calendar: calendar period.
- epoch: custom period. Custom periods are supported only on dedicated instances running version 2.1.19 or later
parameters.help_zh: 重置周期类型。支持自然周期（windowAlignment=calendar）和自定义周期（windowAlignment=epoch）。其中，自定义周期仅适用于 2.1.19 及以上版本的专享实例
parameters.name: window_alignment

parameters.description_en: The period type. Calendar periods support daily, weekly, and monthly statistics. Valid values: day, week, and month. Custom periods support only daily statistics. The value is fixed to day.
parameters.description_zh: 周期类型。自然周期支持按日、周、月统计，取值为 day、week 或 month；自定义周期仅支持按日统计，固定取值为 day
parameters.help_en: The period type. Calendar periods support daily, weekly, and monthly statistics. Valid values: day, week, and month. Custom periods support only daily statistics. The value is fixed to day
parameters.help_zh: 周期类型。自然周期支持按日、周、月统计，取值为 day、week 或 month；自定义周期仅支持按日统计，固定取值为 day
parameters.name: period_type

parameters.description_en: The period multiplier, which specifies the number of periods after which the quota is reset. This parameter is returned when the rule uses a custom period. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 60.
parameters.description_zh: 周期倍数，代表每多少个周期进行配额重置。当规则为自定义周期时返回，最小为1，最大为60。
parameters.help_en: The period multiplier, which specifies the number of periods after which the quota is reset. This parameter is returned when the rule uses a custom period. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 60
parameters.help_zh: 周期倍数，代表每多少个周期进行配额重置。当规则为自定义周期时返回，最小为1，最大为60
parameters.name: period_multiplier

parameters.description_en: The time zone for the calendar period, in UTC+x format.
parameters.description_zh: 自然周期对应的时区(UTC+x格式)
parameters.help_en: The time zone for the calendar period, in UTC+x format
parameters.help_zh: 自然周期对应的时区(UTC+x格式)
parameters.name: timezone

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to perform only a dry run without persisting or applying the configuration. A dry run checks whether conflicting rules exist on the bound consumers. For example, a consumer that already has a calendar-day quota cannot have another calendar-day quota rule added.
parameters.description_zh: 是否仅预检（预检不下发实际配置），用于检查绑定的消费者上是否存在冲突的规则（同一消费者不能配置两个相同周期的自然周期配额，例如已有自然日配额的消费者不能再新增一个自然日配额规则）
parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform only a dry run without persisting or applying the configuration. A dry run checks whether conflicting rules exist on the bound consumers. For example, a consumer that already has a calendar-day quota cannot have another calendar-day quota rule added
parameters.help_zh: 是否仅预检（预检不下发实际配置），用于检查绑定的消费者上是否存在冲突的规则（同一消费者不能配置两个相同周期的自然周期配额，例如已有自然日配额的消费者不能再新增一个自然日配额规则）
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to allow overwriting when conflicts exist. If overwriting is allowed, the conflicting entity (consumer) is unbound from the old rule and bound to the new rule.
parameters.description_zh: 冲突时是否允许覆盖。注意如果选择允许覆盖，冲突主体（消费者）会从旧规则解绑并绑定到新规则
parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to allow overwriting when conflicts exist. If overwriting is allowed, the conflicting entity (consumer) is unbound from the old rule and bound to the new rule
parameters.help_zh: 冲突时是否允许覆盖。注意如果选择允许覆盖，冲突主体（消费者）会从旧规则解绑并绑定到新规则
parameters.name: overwrite

parameters.description_en:
The conflict snapshot hash, used to prevent concurrent dirty overwrites during a confirmed overwrite. Obtain this value from the response of a previous dry run (dryRun=true).

You do not need to specify this parameter in the following cases: no conflicts exist, you are performing a dry run (dryRun=true), or you set overwrite to false.

If dryRun is set to false and overwrite is set to true but this parameter is not specified or the value has expired, the backend returns accepted=false with a new conflict preview. You must perform a new dry run to confirm the updated conflicts.
parameters.description_zh:
冲突快照哈希，用于“确认覆盖时防并发脏覆盖”。通过先执行 dryRun=true 在返回数据提取。

当以下情况不需要填写：没有冲突；只是 dryRun=true 预检；overwrite=false，即不确认覆盖。

当当 dryRun = false 且 overwrite=true 时不带改参数或者该参数过期不匹配，后端会返回：accepted=false 并带新的冲突预览，需要重新执行 dryrun 确认新的冲突。
